title: Accidental Teleportation
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji stepped into that prison cell, the formation runes on the walls suddenly lit up—his movements had long been tracked.

text.content: As the ancient teleportation array's light faded, Chen Ji felt his feet sink, and a cold, damp aura rushed toward him. He opened his eyes to find a dark stone chamber, its dome inlaid with several ghostly green phosphorescent lights, casting the surroundings in an eerie glow. The air was thick with the stench of blood and rotting mold, nearly causing him to retch.

Chen Ji suppressed his rising discomfort and surveyed his surroundings. The stone walls were covered with obscure runes, faintly emanating a chilling Spiritual Energy fluctuation—ancient sealing formation runes, extremely old ones. Beneath his feet lay a massive circular formation disk, similar to the teleportation array they had just activated, but with dozens of additional branches extending from its edges like a spider's web spreading in all directions. "A secret Holy Sect stronghold." Ye Qing's voice cooled, "We've been delivered right into their hands."

Chen Ji didn't answer. All his attention was seized by another sensation—a familiar aura that made his heart stop, emanating from deep within the stone chamber. It was... Chen Nian's presence. Three years. He had searched the entire world, believing his sister long dead, yet now that bloodline connection was so clear, so real, pulling him toward a certain direction. "Chen Ji?" Ye Qing frowned at his suddenly pallid face, "What's wrong?"

dialogue.content: "She's here." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, unrecognizable to himself. "Chen Nian is here."

text.content: Ye Qing's pupils contracted slightly. As a Demon Path Saint, she had naturally heard of Chen Nian—the Heavenly Fate Key, the Chen family orphan, a major fugitive hunted by the Holy Sect for years. But she never expected this supposedly deceased girl to truly be alive, let alone hidden in such an obscure location. "Are you certain?" she asked gravely, "This could be a trap." Chen Ji closed his eyes. The Tianji Record warmed in his mind, and the blurred visions finally gained direction—March seventh, somewhere just ahead.

dialogue.content: "Trap or not," Ye Qing's eyes flickered, "I just sensed the guard presence here is weak. Most personnel seem to have been diverted elsewhere. This is a rare opportunity." She looked at Chen Ji. "How we proceed is your call."

choice.prompt: After sensing his sister's presence, Chen Ji must decide his next course of action—

choices.text: Let Ye Qing lead the infiltration
choices.description: Use Ye Qing's demonic path mist to conceal their presence, quietly approaching the target to avoid alerting the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Time-consuming, may be discovered by patrols
choices.visible_reward: Safely approach the target, time to observe enemy situation

text.content: Ye Qing nodded. A thin layer of black mist rose around her, shrouding both of them. "Don't speak, stay close." Her voice was extremely low, but her steps were steady as a cat's, each precisely avoiding the formation rune patterns on the ground. Chen Ji followed behind her, secretly amazed—this Demon Path Saint's stealth skills were truly well-deserved.

choices.description: The bloodline's call allowed no more waiting. Even exposing their position, he must confirm his sister's safety first.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger trap alarms, alert enemies
choices.risk_hint: Will face the stronghold guards head-on

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate. He charged forward following that familiar aura. Ye Qing froze for an instant, then gritted her teeth and followed. "You're insane!" she hissed urgently, yet her hand had already formed a protective ball of demonic energy around Chen Ji. Chen Ji heard nothing; his eyes saw only ahead—the bloodline connection growing clearer and clearer. His sister was right there!

Passing through three dark corridors and turning two corners, Chen Ji finally saw her. Chen Nian was imprisoned in the center of a massive cell, surrounded by four rune-carved stone pillars with layered barrier after barrier of restriction light enclosing her. Her hands were suspended by chains, clothes in tatters, hair disheveled, dried blood still visible on her cheeks. Yet even so, she still defiantly raised her head—those eyes, those features so identical to his own, even separated by the restriction barriers, made Chen Ji's heart seize with pain.

dialogue.content: "...Brother Ji?" Chen Nian's voice was hoarse and weak, yet trembling with disbelief. "How are you here... No, run! This is a trap!"

text.content: Three years. Chen Ji looked at this emaciated girl before him, his fists clenched until his knuckles whitened. Three years ago when she was abducted, she was still a little girl who would hide behind him and act spoiled; now she had been tortured beyond recognition, locked in this sunless underground prison. He took a deep breath, suppressing the surging killing intent, and was about to speak when a faint tremor came from beneath his feet—coming from deeper within.

Chen Ji followed the tremor with his gaze, his pupils contracting sharply. At the end of the prison cell stood a massive stone gate, from whose seams seeped an eerie crimson light, accompanied by low chanting. That voice was ancient and obscure, like whispers from distant antiquity, each syllable carrying a terrifying power. "This is..." Ye Qing's expression also changed, "A sacrificial ritual?"

Chen Ji closed his eyes. The Tianji Record operated rapidly in his mind. The visions on the fragment gradually clarified—a blood-red altar, stacked corpses, and a massive formation requiring the Chen bloodline as the "catalyst" to activate. The prophecy of March seventh finally presented itself completely. The Holy Sect's intention was not merely to imprison Chen Nian, but to use her blood, her life, to complete some earth-shattering conspiracy.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing peered through the gate's gap. After seeing the scene inside, she drew a sharp breath. "The altar is prepared. Judging by the rune brightness... we have at most three hours." She turned to Chen Ji. "We need to do two things simultaneously—rescue her, and disrupt the ritual. But we're short-handed."

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, his gaze shifting between the prison cell and the stone gate. Chen Nian's restrictions needed to be broken, the ritual at the altar needed to be stopped—both couldn't be delayed, yet simultaneously impossible. His mind raced, calculating every possibility. For three hundred years, he had encountered countless such desperate situations, surviving each time through precise calculation and decisive execution.

choice.prompt: The sacrificial ritual is about to begin. Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.description: His sister was the obsession that had driven him through three hundred years. Anything else could wait; only her life could not be gambled. The ritual could be disrupted later.
choices.visible_cost: May be too late to stop the sacrifice
choices.visible_reward: Ensure Chen Nian's safety, even if the ritual succeeds it becomes meaningless
choices.risk_hint: If the ritual completes, the consequences will be unimaginable

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He walked straight toward the prison cell. "Chen Nian, don't be afraid." His voice was low and firm. "I've come to take you home." He pressed one hand against the restriction barrier. The power of the Tianji Record surged forth instantly—the runes on the ancient fragment resonated with the restrictions, and the layered barriers began cracking. Ye Qing stood guard nearby, vigilantly watching in all directions, ready to act at any moment.

choices.description: Chen Nian has survived three years imprisoned, meaning the ritual still needs her as a living sacrifice. Destroying the altar buys more time.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian may suffer restriction backlash
choices.visible_reward: Fundamentally dismantle the Holy Sect's plan
choices.risk_hint: Breaking the formation will alert everyone

dialogue.content: When Chen Nian heard Chen Ji's plan, her face turned ashen: "No! The altar has heavy guard, and the formation's core... Brother Ji, you don't know how ruthless they are!" Her voice carried a wail. "Please don't risk yourself for me..."

text.content: At this moment, hurried footsteps and shouts came from the distance. Chen Ji's position had indeed been exposed. A guard came running frantically. Upon seeing Chen Ji and his companion, his expression drastically changed. Just as he was about to raise the alarm, a black shadow flashed—the man fell silently. Ye Qing withdrew her hand, her expression calm: "Move faster. They've sent more people." Chen Ji nodded, but his gaze fell on the ground beneath Chen Nian's feet—where the formation runes echoed with those on the altar, faintly outlining a massive formation core.

He understood. This entire underground stronghold was itself a massive formation, and Chen Nian's position happened to be the core. No matter which he saved first or second, once the Holy Sect activated the final formation runes, everything would return to square one. Unless—he could simultaneously destroy both the core and the altar in the same instant. A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. For three hundred years, his specialty had been finding that sole path to survival in absolute desperation.

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing, I need you to do one thing." Chen Ji's voice regained its usual calm. "Go to the altar. Use your demonic path mist to cover those formation runes there. Hold out as long as you can." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "And you?" Chen Ji didn't answer. He merely raised his hand, and the Tianji Record slowly emerged in his palm, radiating an ancient and mysterious glow. Mo Xiansheng had said—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fate backlash—but sometimes, backlash itself is the sharpest weapon.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji decides to use the Tianji Record as the core to simultaneously destroy both formation points. This will bring enormous backlash—

choices.description: Consume large amounts of Heavenly Fate, using the Tianji Record's power to strike both the formation core and altar simultaneously, killing two birds with one stone.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate will be greatly consumed, may trigger unknown backlash
choices.visible_reward: Simultaneously destroy both formation cores, completely dismantle the Holy Sect's plan
choices.risk_hint: The degree of backlash is unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He poured his entire being into the Tianji Record. The ancient fragment suddenly blazed with blinding golden light, and an enormous stream of information surged into his consciousness—this was backlash of foresight, and also gift of foresight. For three hundred years, he had never "seen" the future so clearly: every fissure in the formation runes, every pause in the chanting, every trace of fear in the guards' eyes—all was laid bare before him.

choices.description: Only destroy the formation core, rescue Chen Nian, then retreat in the chaos without confronting the Holy Sect directly. Deal with the altar threat another day.
choices.visible_cost: The altar remains, the Holy Sect may still complete the ritual
choices.visible_reward: Safely rescue Chen Nian, preserve strength

text.content: After brief consideration, Chen Ji chose the more prudent plan. He turned to Ye Qing: "I'll break the formation core first. You provide cover outside. If things turn bad, we retreat immediately." Ye Qing nodded. Her demonic path mist had already silently spread, concealing their presence completely. Chen Ji took a deep breath. The Tianji Record's power began gathering in his palm, but he deliberately restrained its volume.
